name: lingua-magna
description: Mastery-gated language learning (Mandarin, Spanish, English, French, Italian, Portuguese, German). Static site + in-browser engine.

scripts.data: npm run data:fetch && npm run data:build
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run engine && eleventy --quiet && node scripts/og.mjs && node scripts/postbuild.mjs && node scripts/tag-outbound.mjs _site linguamagna.pages.dev lingua-mastery.pages.dev
scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/inlinks.mjs && node --test scripts/outbound-utm.test.mjs
